edition_evidence.state: original-edition metadata represented in Open Library edition history and reprint notes; physical copy/full text not acquired in this cycle
reprint identity verified; Open Library indicates preview/locate rather than unrestricted download

edition_uncertainty.note: Other library/reprint records encountered by MLHKP contain differing modern reprint dates and at least one conflicting note about original-publication year. These are preserved as catalogue-level edition uncertainty rather than normalized by guess.
edition_uncertainty.canonicalization_rule: Canonicalize the intellectual work separately from each manifestation/edition; do not collapse publication year, publisher, pagination, or rights fields across editions unless an authoritative edition relationship is verified.

ingestion_boundary.reason: Exact edition/full-text rights and reuse permission are not established.
